title: Mother with Baby Carriage, Park Floral Dress - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor snapshot from the mid-1940s featuring a fashionable young woman standing beside a classic baby carriage in a city park. She is dressed in a bold floral-patterned two-piece suit with structured shoulders and a matching pleated skirt, accented by a floral hair accessory popular during the 1940s. Park benches, pavement, and a chain-link fence line the background.
